queries: California Labor Code 2810.5 wage theft prevention notice required content

assertions.text: written notice at hire to non-exempt employees
rate and basis of pay, allowances, regular payday, employer name and dba, workers' compensation carrier
reissue within seven (7) days of a change not shown on the next wage statement
in the language the employer normally uses
physical and mailing address of the main office and telephone number
assertions.note: not mentioned in any source found

gaps: The notice must state whether a federal or state disaster declaration applies to the county of employment. The clause omits this requirement entirely.
